text:
The actual latest image has 16 cells (4 rows) and its empty front arm stays forward in EVERY pose. Your description says backward swing, but the image does not show it. Please correct these visible failures rather than describing them as fixed.




Return exactly TWELVE complete poses in FOUR columns and THREE rows, no fourth row and no black grid lines. Use the original uploaded sheet's smooth KH2 Sora artwork and camera. Preserve the far/rear bent carrying arm and visibly closed hand in the Kingdom Key guard over its own shoulder in every pose. Keep exactly two arms and one rigid connected weapon; no empty guard or switched carry.




Explicit empty FRONT arm pose schedule, count cells left-to-right/top-to-bottom without adding numbers: cells1,2,3 front elbow drawn downward/backward, EMPTY front glove beside/behind the hip to the LEFT of its shoulder; cells4,5,6 transition and swing forward to RIGHT below blade; cells7,8,9 front empty arm forward, bent; cells10,11,12 return through downward/backward empty-glove poses LEFT of its front shoulder. In the backward poses visibly connect the arm to the FRONT sleeve near the chest while preserving the separate far bent carrying elbow and shoulder grip. Do not move the far carrying elbow down instead. Both backward and forward silhouettes must be obvious.




Legs must alternate far/near support across the two half-strides with contact, compression, passing, push-off and flight. Constant character/head/shoe sizes, limb lengths and weapon design/length. Fixed camera and common floor, genuine different joints, complete hair/boots/weapon inside each cell with white gutters. Last pose should lead into first smoothly. No text, no scene, no video. Inspect the requested frame count and actual backward empty-arm silhouettes before returning the new full sheet.
